description: ESP32-S3 firmware that drives a TTL monochrome MDA or Hercules type monitor at 720x350.

glossary.MDA: The IBM Monochrome Display Adapter signal: 720x350 pixels, 18.43 kHz horizontal, about 50 Hz vertical, TTL levels on a DE-9 connector.
glossary.Bounce buffer: A pair of small internal RAM buffers that the RGB LCD driver fills from a framebuffer in PSRAM and sends to the pins.
glossary.Porch: The blank pixels or lines between the end of the picture and the sync pulse (front porch) or after it (back porch).
